description: Compare answers from configured engines and inspect disagreement, with lexical similarity and final-answer agreement when measurable.

antagonist.description: When true, forces one engine to act as adversarial red-team antagonist.

depth.description: intuitive and fast route to one engine; executive, pioneer and deep route a multi-engine dispatch (free callers: two engines first, expanding on measured divergence, one deep solve per day). Any other value is refused.

model.description: Label echoed in the result. Every value dispatches through the same registered engines; depth decides fast or multi-engine.

query.description: The core inquiry, hypothesis, or decision challenge to synthesize.
